entities.summary: Jayce Hawryluk is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is under contract with EHC Kloten of the Swiss National League. He was selected by the Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the second round, 32nd overall, of the 2014 NHL entry draft. He also played with the Vancouver Canucks and Ottawa Senators of the NHL, Skellefteå AIK of the Swedish Hockey League, HC Bílí Tygři Liberec of the Czech Extraliga, and HC Nové Zámky of the Slovak Extraliga.
